intro.title: Curious, creative, and always learning.
paragraphs: I am a third-year Computer Science student at Amsterdam University of Applied Sciences (AUAS/HvA) and a developer who enjoys turning ideas into useful web experiences.
I like working on the details that make a product feel right: clear layouts and code that is easy to understand and build on.

highlights.title: Outside of coding
highlights.text: In my free time, I enjoy playing games and programming. Games are a way for me to relax, but they also inspire my interest in design, problem-solving, and the way people interact with technology.

highlights.title: What motivates me
highlights.text: I enjoy learning tools, exploring creative ideas, and improving through every project. Whether I am building a page from scratch or polishing a small detail, I care about making the end result feel useful.

focus.title: Building with purpose
focus.text: I combine technical quality with design awareness. My goal is to create responsive, accessible interfaces that are reliable for the people using them and enjoyable to develop.
